description: Issue #948 (review round PR #955, finding F3): neutralizes the egress-policy consultation inside RestWidgetDataSource.SelectConnectableIpAsync's per-candidate foreach loop by prefixing the approval condition with a compile-preserving 'false &&' -- the right-hand `await egressPolicy.IsAllowedAsync(...)` is never evaluated (short-circuited), so the policy is silently never actually consulted, even though the surrounding null-check ('if (egressPolicy == null) return null;') is untouched and still passes. This is the connect-time, TOCTOU-safe layer that PinnedConnectAsync's SocketsHttpHandler.ConnectCallback actually uses -- ValidateUrlAsync (the fast pre-check) now calls this same method directly, so this mutant also covers that caller. red_tests cover both directions: an approving policy that should grant access to a private-network candidate and to a plain-HTTP candidate (both regress to null instead of the expected IP), and a denying policy's call-count assertion (drops from every-candidate-tried to zero calls, since the await is never reached). green_test is the sibling positive control that exercises the SAME method's fast path (a public IP candidate mixed with a private one, no policy needed) -- it never reaches the mutated line at all, so it must stay green.
target_symbol: RestWidgetDataSource.SelectConnectableIpAsync(IPAddress[], Uri, int, bool, IDashboardEgressPolicy?, CancellationToken) -- the per-candidate egressPolicy.IsAllowedAsync(...) consultation inside the foreach loop, line ~538
red_expected_assertion_patterns_observed: Captured against this branch's working tree (stale demo.db under bin/ removed first) with the mutant patch applied via `dotnet test ... --filter <red_test_filter>`: 'Assert.AreEqual failed. Expected:<10.0.0.1>. Actual:<(null)>.', 'Assert.AreEqual failed. Expected:<2>. Actual:<0>. a denying policy must be asked about every candidate before giving up', and 'Assert.AreEqual failed. Expected:<8.8.8.8>. Actual:<(null)>.' -- all three declared red_tests failed with exactly these messages; no other test in the same filter's TRX went red.
